Awaiting acceptance. Will send full follow-up message once each accepts.

Interview requires deploying BCM to a VM beforehand. 2+ yrs required but realistic candidate pool is 4-5 yrs infrastructure PM. Deadline 4/19/2026. Applied for practice and long shot exposure.

OH eligible for remote. 20-25% travel expected. Strong compensation well above target. Claude Code and Bus Routing Pro API experience are differentiators.

Transportation Management System (TMS) SaaS for freight/shipping. Direct domain match with Busology transportation experience. 1-2+ yrs required - I match. Equivalent experience accepted for degree. UAT validation and bug fix validation are core responsibilities. EDI work called out. Base $70-90K plus uncapped commission. Strong fit overall. Similar role to Vector application.

EHS (Environmental Health Safety) SaaS platform. Strong technical match - SQL, XML, JSON, JavaScript, APIs with Postman, advanced Excel all match my skills. 2+ yrs SQL Server required (I have 2). 1+ yr Open XML required. No degree requirement. 100% remote. Ryan Bass is recruiting contact - follow up via LinkedIn 48 hrs after submission. Salary not posted - likely $75-90K range. Customer Success + Implementation hybrid role, closely matches Busology work pattern. Followed up with Ryan Bass on Linked in. Left note for connect.

Cybersecurity TAM for BloodHound Enterprise (identity attack path mapping). 3+ yrs required in security industry - stretch since I have 2 yrs general tech. Core TAM work (onboarding, integrations, churn management, voice of customer) matches Busology work. Python, PowerShell, REST API skills all match requirements. Base $100-130K plus stock options and strong benefits. Steffany V. is recruiting manager and job poster - follow up via LinkedIn 48 hrs after submission.

Series A fintech startup using AI for financial wellness. Raised $41M including $33M Series A in 2023 from Citi Ventures Left Lane Wellington Flourish Vestigo. ~40 employees remote across 4 time zones. Role explicitly for first or second PM role. Base $90-110K plus equity. No degree required. Strong personal fit - I am a target user of their product given credit rebuilding journey. AI-built product angle relevant to my Claude Code experience. 5-stage hiring process with take-home challenge.

Series A startup building AI-powered tools for online fitness coaches. Real APM role with actual PM work (PRDs, roadmap, prioritization, QA, SQL analytics). 1-3 yrs product or product-adjacent experience required - I qualify via Busology work. SQL dashboards Figma Linear Notion. No degree required. $80-120K base plus equity. Fully remote but PT hours overlap required. AI-powered product is strong differentiator for me given Claude Code experience. Real PM title opportunity.

Anaconda is THE Python/data science platform - 95% Fortune 500 use it, 50M users, Insight Partners backed. Product Operations Manager role - operational engine for product team. 3+ yrs required, I'm at 2 (stretch). Claude listed by name as required tool - rare specific match for me. Jira and Confluence required (have). Monday.com required. Base $100-147K, realistic $100-115K. Fully remote. Deadline 6/22/2026. Strong fit, application open until filled.

Adtech/podcast advertising intelligence platform. Real entry-level PM role - no specific years required just "experience shipping SaaS products". Responsibilities map closely to my Busology work (QA UAT pattern identification in support tickets backlog management). Base $80-120K plus variable. Realistic $85-95K. Fully remote no state restrictions. Small team big influence framing. Data-heavy product. Adtech domain ramp required but flexible.

Structured finance data analytics platform. 400+ financial institutions as customers. TPM role for developer tooling APIs and MCP server. Claude Code explicitly listed as required qualification - rare match for me. 1-2 yrs as developer tool PM required - I have zero formal PM but extensive API building via Bus Routing Pro. Side project clause in engineering requirements likely applies. Base $135-150K very strong. Highest compensation in current pipeline. Stretch on PM experience but unique match on Claude Code and API portfolio.
